A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

clause.title: extent
clause.p: The extent of the features in the collection. In the Core only spatial and temporal extents are specified. Extensions may add additional members to represent other extents, for example, thermal or pressure ranges.

tr.td: The spatial extent of the features in the collection.
The temporal extent of the features in the collection.

clause.title: numberMatched
clause.p: The number of features of the feature type that match the selection parameters like bbox.

clause.title: numberReturned
clause.p: The number of features in the feature collection.
A server may omit this information in a response, if the information about the number of features is not known or difficult to compute.
If the value is provided, the value shall be identical to the number of items in the “features” array.

clause.title: timeStamp
clause.p: This property indicates the time and date when the response was generated.
